title: Never publish DeltaDictum benchmark numbers on the site: the benchmark is not public, even though the supermem repo has them
body: The DeltaDictum benchmark is NOT public. Do not show anything from it: recorded run counts, the requirements-met rates with vs without DD, task or project counts, hook latency, or the benchmark's finding against DD. That holds even though C:\dev\supermem\docs\benchmarks has the numbers and an earlier iteration showed them (the author removed them, 2026-10-26). The race in dd.ts is labelled 'ilustrativo' and claims no numbers. Only public facts from DD's README, CHANGELOG and site are allowed: the npm version, the supported harnesses, the first-commit → 1.0 dates, the license. The installation block was also removed in favour of one link to DD's docs. This matters most when DD moves out of the hard-coded constants in src/pages/v2.astro into content.es.json/content.en.json as a Project (a pending TODO): the comment that guards this today does not travel with the data, and metric 'source's must point at public files only.
not_derivable: The guard is a comment in v2.astro that is lost when the data moves into the dataset; the private numbers are one directory away in the supermem repo.

evidence.summary: Comment above the dd constants: the benchmark is NOT public, so nothing from it appears here
Spike iteration 7 (2026-10-26): author removed every benchmark number; do not bring it back.
